description: USE WHEN you suspect a capital-diversified portfolio hides one dominant risk factor. A portfolio can be capital-diversified while its RISK is dominated by one factor. Returns the Euler risk contribution of each holding (RC_i = w_i*(Sigma*w)_i / w'Sigma*w, summing to 1) beside the capital weights, from the empirical covariance of real returns. Proxies: SPY=equity beta, TLT=duration, GOLD=real asset, BTC=crypto. E.g. a 60/40 is ~83% equity risk, a 50/50 SPY/BTC ~86% BTC risk. Descriptive, not advisory.

holdings.description: Portfolio legs: list of {asset, weight} objects, e.g. [{'asset': 'SPY', 'weight': 0.6}, {'asset': 'TLT', 'weight': 0.4}]. Assets: SPY, TLT, GOLD, BTC or CASH (aliases GLD, BTC-USD). Weights are normalised to sum to 1 and MAY be negative here (a net short leg); at most 50 legs, no duplicates. Each substrate asset proxies a factor (SPY=equity beta, TLT=duration, GOLD=real asset, BTC=crypto).
